findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_buyers, get_tool_terms · Private data: list_buyers, get_market_facts, get_tool_terms, estimate, code_value · Public sink: list_buyers, get_tool_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_buyers, get_tool_terms · Private data: list_buyers, get_market_facts, get_tool_terms, estimate, code_value · Public sink: list_buyers, get_tool_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
